evaluation.results_summary: Mistral 7B Instruct is reported to outperform all 7B models on MT-Bench and to be comparable to 13B chat models.
evaluation.safety_evals: The model is reported to have no moderation mechanisms.

identity.name: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1
identity.summary: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 is a 7-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model derived from Mistral-7B-v0.1.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: instruction-tuned chat model with no moderation mechanisms and no reported factuality/grounding evaluations -> likely to produce factually inaccurate content

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight chat model reported to outperform 7B models and comparable to 13B chat models, with no moderation or reliability evaluations -> users may over-trust its outputs

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight instruction-tuned model with no moderation mechanisms -> users may send confidential information in prompts without safeguards

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight instruction-tuned model with no moderation mechanisms -> users may include copyrighted or IP-protected text in prompts

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,498,040 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was produced by instruction fine-tuning the base Mistral-7B-v0.1 model on publicly available conversation datasets.
training_context.training_data: The target checkpoint is an instruction fine-tune of the Mistral-7B-v0.1 base model, trained on a variety of publicly available conversation datasets.
